meaning:
1) to run, run about, rush, run to and fro, be eager or greedy or thirsty
1a) (Qal) roving, ranging, longing, rush out upon (participle)
1b) (Hithpalpel) to rush to and fro, rush back and forth

renderings.kjv: They shall run to and fro
they shall justle one against another

elsewhere.note: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he…
They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.
